_doc: TOP-UP packs. 'enabled' is the one switch: while it is false the TOP-UP button and every pay button (month card, limit packs...) show disabledTip and nothing is credited; chat /topup still works for testing. Set it to true and restart the server to turn top-up back on (players get the new state at their next lobby entry). When enabled there is no payment: buying credits the diamonds (payYuanbao) locally. firstBonus applies to the first purchase of each pack. See backend_server/features/topup.py. Any other pay goods id credits unlistedDiamonds.
disabledTip: Top up is disabled as of now, contact the administrator.
